pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
[Female Vocal - airy whisper + soft hum]
(soft pulsing pads, distant water-drop pluck, wide reverb, tender yet aching atmosphere)

Your shadow in my eyes… trembling…
Why do we keep missing each other…

[Verse 1]
[Female Vocal]
(behind-the-beat, breathy, locked to kick/snare)

Shadows shaking in your eyes
Every word you said put me on edge
I couldn’t say a single thing
Just froze inside your misunderstanding

[Pre-Chorus]
[Female Vocal]
(sub bass follows kick, minimal pads)

Sighs leaking through the cracks
Slowly erasing our names
It’s love, it really is love
So why do we keep going wrong?

[Hook]
[Female Vocal - phonetic loop]
(slight silence before, then full groove impact)

We love too much… it hurts
Sincerity becomes a wall between us
I stood there with a locked voice
Saying no… no… over and over

[Chorus]
[Female Vocal]
(repeat hook with layered airy ad-libs)

We love too much… it hurts
Truth becomes the wall that divides us
I’m sorry… I was scared to lose you
That’s why I kept hesitating

[Verse 2]
[Female Vocal]
(more textured rasp, close mic)

My “I’m sorry” and “I love you”
Cut like blades when they crossed
The more I explained, the deeper the misunderstanding
The harder I held on, the farther you went

[Pre-Chorus 2]
[Female Vocal]
(pads pulse stronger)

But I’m still you, even now
My heart embraces even your misunderstandings
I cry because I love you, I love you because I cry
This foolish me is still standing here

[Hook 2]
[Female Vocal]
(stronger groove, add light vocal fry)

We love too much… it hurts
Sincerity becomes a wall between us
Just once… only once
See me as I really am

[Chorus 2]
[Female Vocal]
(full layers, humming in background)

We love too much… it hurts
Truth becomes the wall that divides us
I’m sorry… I was scared to lose you
That’s why everything went wrong

[Bridge]
[Female Vocal - half-whisper]
(everything drops to sub bass + soft pads)

Broken words… painful faces…
They were all love… just love…

[Rap]
[Female Vocal - low, breathy, close]
(exact drum interlock, behind snare)

One chance, just one more chance
Let my real heart shine through your doubt
We believed even the misunderstandings were love
Let’s face each other again as love
Let’s love again… please let’s love again
Yeah… crossed hearts…

[Break]
[Instrumental + Humming]
(only water-drop pluck + pulsing pads, airy hums)

[Final Chorus]
[Female Vocal]
(max layers, rich reverb)

We love too much… it hurts
But our hearts are still calling
Let’s love again… please love again
Even if it’s crossed… let’s try once more

[Outro]
[Female Vocal - fading]
(heavy reverb, last syllable fry, slow fade)

Let’s love again… please…
(soft humming till end)
pkg.sunoStyle: Groovy airy electro-pop with groove. Minimal, rhythm-driven, laid-back, subtly sensual. Tempo: 92 BPM, slight swing, behind-the-beat feel. Drums: kick on 1 and 3, ghost kicks between; snare/clap on 2 and 4. Arrangement: resonant sub bass follows kick, pulsing pads drive rhythm, water-drop pluck for melody. Sound: clean airy mix, controlled reverb, soft delay, wide stereo. Vocal: female, distinct raspy, airy-textured, mature tone. Texture: pronounced rasp, audible vocal fry, slight grit. Style: spoken word, rap cadence. NOT singing. Rules: no melody, no sustain. Each word separate. Hard stop each phrase. Timing: lock to beat grid, words align with kick/snare hits. Phrasing: choppy, staccato, clipped, groove-synced. Delivery: percussive, consonant-driven. Pitch: near-monotone. Flow: relaxed, slightly behind snare but locked. Ending: last syllable extended, raspy breathy fade with fry. Core: drum-locked spoken vocal over bass, pads, water pluck.
